scope: The trace replays contain actual measured bytes and EOS, with no pressure multiplier. Source projections pick disjoint original adjacent pairs, with at least four observed natural EOS lengths each. The envelope fixes their historical median-low work and models the pressure of their own KV checkpoints using prior realized read fractions, port skew, and P/D timing. Favorable sensitivity assumes every predicted remote read and passes all predicted wave service delta through to drain. This is a conditional planning calculation. APC/Store residency, proxy release order, and future EOS can change for new combinations, especially if new arrivals outlast the first P credit.
